pub fn from_bcp47_language_tag(tag: &str) -> Option<Self> {
    let normalized = tag.trim().replace('_', "-").to_ascii_lowercase();
    let mut parts = normalized.split('-').filter(|part| !part.is_empty());
    let language = parts.next()?;
    let region = parts.next().unwrap_or("");

    match (language, region) {
        ("en", "") | ("en", "us") => Some(LocaleId::EnUs),
        ("en", "gb") => Some(LocaleId::EnGb),
        ("en", "ie") => Some(LocaleId::EnIe),
        ("en", "au") => Some(LocaleId::EnAu),
        ("en", "nz") => Some(LocaleId::EnNz),
        ("en", "za") => Some(LocaleId::EnZa),
        ("en", "in") => Some(LocaleId::EnIn),
        ("en", "ca") => Some(LocaleId::EnCa),
        ("en", "ph") => Some(LocaleId::EnPh),
        ("de", _) => Some(LocaleId::DeDe),
        ("ru", _) => Some(LocaleId::RuRu),
        ("fi", _) => Some(LocaleId::FiFi),
        ("et", _) => Some(LocaleId::EtEe),
        ("lv", _) => Some(LocaleId::LvLv),
        ("lt", _) => Some(LocaleId::LtLt),
        ("sk", _) => Some(LocaleId::SkSk),
        ("cs", _) => Some(LocaleId::CsCz),
        ("nb", _) => Some(LocaleId::NbNo),
        ("nn", _) => Some(LocaleId::NnNo),
        ("fr", _) => Some(LocaleId::FrFr),
        ("es", _) => Some(LocaleId::EsEs),
        ("pt", "") | ("pt", "pt") => Some(LocaleId::PtPt),
        ("pt", "br") => Some(LocaleId::PtBr),
        ("it", _) => Some(LocaleId::ItIt),
        ("nl", _) => Some(LocaleId::NlNl),
        ("pl", _) => Some(LocaleId::PlPl),
        ("zh", _) => Some(LocaleId::ZhCn),
        ("ja", _) => Some(LocaleId::JaJp),
        ("ko", _) => Some(LocaleId::KoKr),
        ("hu", _) => Some(LocaleId::HuHu),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn eval_value_from_output_shape(
    values: &[f64],
    shape: OutputShape,
) -> Result<CalcValue, WorksheetErrorCode> {
    match shape {
        OutputShape::Scalar => Ok(CalcValue::number(values[0])),
        OutputShape::Row(cols) => CalcArray::from_rows(vec![
            values
                .iter()
                .copied()
                .take(cols)
                .map(CalcValue::number)
                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        ])
        .map(CalcValue::array)
        .ok_or(WorksheetErrorCode::Value),
        OutputShape::Column(rows) => CalcArray::from_rows(
            values
                .iter()
                .copied()
                .take(rows)
                .map(|value| vec![CalcValue::number(value)])
                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        )
        .map(CalcValue::array)
        .ok_or(WorksheetErrorCode::Value),
        OutputShape::Matrix { rows, cols } => {
            let row_major = values
                .chunks(cols)
                .take(rows)
                .map(|chunk| chunk.iter().copied().map(CalcValue::number).collect())
                .collect::<Vec<Vec<CalcValue>>>();
            CalcArray::from_rows(row_major)
                .map(CalcValue::array)
                .ok_or(WorksheetErrorCode::Value)
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn from_number(code: i64) -> Option<Self> {

        4 => [false, true, true, false, false, false, false],
        5 => [false, false, true, true, false, false, false],
        6 => [false, false, false, true, true, false, false],
        7 => [false, false, false, false, true, true, false],
        11 => [false, false, false, false, false, false, true],
        12 => [true, false, false, false, false, false, false],
        13 => [false, true, false, false, false, false, false],
        14 => [false, false, true, false, false, false, false],
        15 => [false, false, false, true, false, false, false],
        16 => [false, false, false, false, true, false, false],
        17 => [false, false, false, false, false, true, false],
        _ => return None,
    };
    Some(Self { monday_first })
}
